[]).includes(b) so a directed edge a→b is detected by scanning a's adjacency list. Tests (test/graph.test.ts) were not modified. Shell execution was blocked by the harness allowlist, so the suite could not be run locally; the fix was verified by direct inspection of each tested function against the test expectations.
